item.title: Singapore: Insights into Early Screen Exposure and Development
item.description: A long-term Singapore study shows that screen exposure in the first two years of life is linked to lasting changes in brain development, while active parental engagement, such as reading, can help support healthier outcomes.

item.title: India: Advancing AI Innovation from Research to Reality
item.description: India is rapidly building a robust AI ecosystem, combining government investment, skilled talent, thriving startups and innovation, research and collaboration to drive economic growth and real-world societal impact.

item.title: Malaysia: Melaka Harnesses AI to Drive Smart Tourism
item.description: Melaka is embedding advanced AI across its tourism ecosystem to enhance visitor experiences, streamline operations and support data-driven planning while boosting economic growth and competitiveness.

item.title: Vietnam: AI and Digital Tools Reshape the Realty Sector
item.description: Vietnam’s real estate brokerage sector is increasingly embracing AI, big data and integrated digital tools to enhance professionalism, streamline workflows and fully empower brokers for a Tech 4.0 future.

item.title: Hong Kong: Digital Policy Office Launches CorpID Sandbox
item.description: Hong Kong’s Digital Corporate Identity Sandbox Programme allows organisations to test secure corporate authentication, streamline digital transactions and prepare for the city’s unified digital identity platform.

item.title: Malaysia: Smart Imaging Tech Strengthens Agricultural Inspection
item.description: UTM develops AI-enabled scanner to assess durian quality without damage, boosting export standards and advancing agricultural imaging innovation in Malaysia.

item.title: India: NICDC Powers Smart Logistics and Data-Driven Trade
item.description: NICDC Logistics Data Services Limited marks a decade of driving India’s logistics digitisation, strengthening supply chains, trade competitiveness and smart, data-driven infrastructure through LDB 2.0 and ULIP.

item.title: Hong Kong: Enhancing AI-Driven Life Sciences Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong’s science and technology ecosystem is accelerating life sciences innovation, using AI, digital platforms, and public research infrastructure to translate biomedical breakthroughs into commercial impact.

item.title: Vietnam: Building Digital Capabilities for a High-Tech Economy
item.description: Vietnam is advancing a science, technology and innovation strategy that leverages digital capabilities, global partnerships and local talent to support its transition towards a high-tech, innovation-driven economy.

item.title: Singapore: Applied AI Innovation to Empower SMEs
item.description: Nanyang Polytechnic has launched an applied AI initiative that connects students with real business challenges, helping SMEs adopt practical artificial intelligence solutions while developing future-ready digital talent.
